title: CloudVault
tagline: A secure cloud storage experience powered by Telegram infrastructure.
description: CloudVault utilizes Telegram's infrastructure via TDLib as a secure, infinite cloud storage backend while presenting a modern drive interface with folder hierarchy, file previews, and smart caching.
problem: Traditional cloud storage services enforce expensive subscription tiers and storage caps.
solution: Built natively in Kotlin using Jetpack Compose, TDLib, MVVM, Room database, and Coroutines for seamless cloud file management.
highlights: Large file chunking & smart local Room cache
Offline file availability & instant folder search
